# Cravora Solutions

> Cravora Solutions is a custom software development company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We build high-performance web applications, mobile apps, SaaS MVPs, and AI/automation integrations for startups and enterprises across 12+ countries.

## Core Services

- Web Application Development: Custom full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and Cloud Infrastructure. (https://cravorasolutions.com/services/web-application-development)
- Mobile App Development: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native and Flutter. (https://cravorasolutions.com/services/mobile-app-development)
- SaaS Development & MVP Builder: Rapid 6-8 week MVP design, development, and launch for tech founders. (https://cravorasolutions.com/services/saas-development)
- AI & Automation Solutions: Custom LLM integrations, OpenAI GPT-4 API workflows, and workflow automation. (https://cravorasolutions.com/services/ai-automation-solutions)
- MVP Development: Lean, scalable software MVPs engineered for early traction and investor pitch readiness. (https://cravorasolutions.com/services/mvp-development)

## Key Information

- Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (380015)
- Email: info@cravorasolutions.com
- Website: https://cravorasolutions.com
- Delivery Stats: 50+ projects shipped, 98% on-time delivery rate, clients across 12 countries.
